plainTranslation: A's need for freedom meets B's love and values. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their unpredictability and push for change work smoothly with your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
summaryDeep: Their unpredictability and push for change work smoothly with your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
